cues: Tuberculosis is Nepal's most important bacterial disease.
Mycobacterium tuberculosis has a waxy wall full of mycolic acid, which makes it slow growing, tough, and impossible to stain the normal way.
So we use the Ziehl Neelsen method.
Flood the sputum smear with red carbol fuchsin and heat it, driving the dye through the wax.
